'''May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG constructed tournament held on Sunday 25 May 2003 at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, Minnesota, the first of four constructed tournaments in MNSWCCG's "Road to States" series in the four weeks before the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]] weekend of 20–21 June.<ref name="pcf-1291-27254">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=27254#27254 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Sixteen players took part, including [[Nick Kolnik]], who played to avoid a bye.<ref name="pcf-1291-27254" />

[[Mark Peterson]], playing [[Luke's Bionic Hand]], won as the only undefeated player of the day with a final score of 8 (+65); it was his second tournament win of 2003. Three of his four wins came against other 2003 MNSWCCG tournament winners: [[Derek Van Beusekom]], [[Michael Raveling]] and Kolnik.<ref name="pcf-1291-27254" /> Players of the Rosemount group, built up by former Squadron Member [[Mark Walseth]], took part.<ref name="pcf-1291-27254" />
